name: Cable Standing Straight Leg Glute Kickback
cardText:
Cable Standing Straight Leg Glute Kickback
Beginner
1
Use an ankle attachment. The cable should be set to the bottom of the crossover machine.
2
Push your ankle straight back, extending at the hip. Hold for a one count when you feel a contraction in your glutes.
3
Then flex at the hips until you are back into your original position.

name: Cable Bar Romanian Deadlift
cardText:
Cable Bar Romanian Deadlift
Beginner
1
Start with a straight bar or ez bar attachment set to the bottom of the machine. Squat the weight up into a standing position and walk a few steps back
2
Push your butt back to initiate the movement and then push your butt forward until you're back in a standing position.
3
To protect yourself from injury, always maintain a flat back on any exercise.

name: Cable Goblet Squat
cardText:
Cable Goblet Squat
Novice
1
Start with a straight bar or easy bar attachment .
2
Get your elbows directly underneath the bar, squat straight up and then walk back a few steps.
3
Break at your knees and hips to initiate the squat. Make sure you maintain a flat back.
4
Squat all the way back to a standing position.

name: Cable Single Leg Deadlift
cardText:
Cable Single Leg Deadlift
Advanced
1
Start with a straight bar or easy bar attachment. Squat the weight up into a standing position and walk a few steps back.
2
Push your butt back to initiate the movement while lifting one of your legs. Then push your butt forward until you're back in a standing position.
3
Compete your given amount of reps, then switch to opposite leg.
4
To protect yourself from injury, always maintain a flat back.

name: Cable Pull Through
cardText:
Cable Pull Through
Beginner
1
This exercise works best with a rope attachment but can be done with anything. The attachment should be set to the bottom of the machine.
2
Face away from the cable machine, straddle the cable itself, and grab the attachment. Walk a few steps away.
3
Break at the hips while maintaining a flat back and mostly extended knees.
4
Push hips forward until you are back in a standing position.

name: Cable Elevated Deadlift
cardText:
Cable Elevated Deadlift
Intermediate
1
Start with handles set to the bottom of the machine. Grab a box, stand on top of the box, squat the weight up into a standing position.
2
Push your butt back to initiate the movement and then push your butt forward until you're back in a standing position.
3
To protect yourself from injury, always maintain a flat back on any exercise.

name: Cable Bar Staggered Romanian Deadlift
cardText:
Cable Bar Staggered Romanian Deadlift
Intermediate
1
Start with a straight bar attachment set to the bottom of the machine. Squat the weight up into a standing position and walk a few steps back.
2
Stand with a staggered stance. Push your butt back to initiate the movement and then push your butt forward until you're back in a standing position.
3
To protect yourself from injury, always maintain a flat back on any exercise.

name: Cable Zercher Good Morning
cardText:
Cable Zercher Good Morning
Advanced
1
Begin by standing with your feet about hip-width apart and holding the bar in the crook of your elbows, with your palms facing towards your body.
2
Keeping your core engaged and your back straight, bend at the hips and lower your torso forward until it is nearly parallel to the ground.
3
Push through your heels to extend your hips and raise your body back to the starting position.

name: Cable Standing Straight Leg Mid Kickback
cardText:
Cable Standing Straight Leg Mid Kickback
Beginner
1
Use an ankle attachment. The cable should be set to halfway up the crossover machine.
2
Push your ankle straight back, extending at the hip. Hold for a one count when you feel a contraction in your glutes.
3
Then flex at the hips until you are back into your original position.

name: Cable Standing Mid Kickback
cardText:
Cable Standing Mid Kickback
Beginner
1
Use an ankle attachment. The cable should be set halfway up the crossover machine.
2
Start with a bent knee position. Push your ankle straight back, extending at the hip. Hold for a one count when you feel a contraction in your glutes.
3
Then flex at the hips until you are back into your original position.

name: Cable Bench Straight Leg Kickback
cardText:
Cable Bench Straight Leg Kickback
Beginner
1
Use an ankle attachment. Bring a bench over to the cables. The cable should be set to hip height.
2
Push your ankle straight back, extending at the hip. Hold for a one count when you feel a contraction in your glutes.
3
Then flex at the hips until you are back into your original position.

name: Cable Incline Bench Straight Leg Kickback
cardText:
Cable Incline Bench Straight Leg Kickback
Beginner
1
Use an ankle attachment. Bring a bench over to the cables. Put the bench at incline level. The cable should be set to shoulder height.
2
Push your ankle straight back, extending at the hip. Hold for a one count when you feel a contraction in your glutes.
3
Then flex at the hips until you are back into your original position.

name: Cable Zercher Squat
cardText:
Cable Zercher Squat
Intermediate
1
Start with a straight bar or easy bar attachment .
2
Place the bar in your elbows, squat straight up and then walk back a few steps.
3
Break at your knees and hips to initiate the squat. Make sure you maintain a flat back.
4
Squat all the way back to a standing position.
